revisit.resolution: The same pinned original appeared in full on the single revisit; Korean and detail text and metal finish became inspectable.
revisit.reason: Resolve the initial incomplete native display without changing the asset.

text.raster_limit: Visible glyph classes are transcribed; original Unicode code points cannot be certified from raster marks.

style.checked_requirement: Explicit monochrome, neutral black/white/grayscale; museum daily-life tone
style.observations: No visible chromatic accent or sepia. No horror props or commercial antique labels.

substantive_non_glyph.observations: Two large photographic hardware regions take about 63% of height; the lever mount and inserted key/cylinder provide subject-specific functional content.

layout_fidelity.observations: All copy in central white area between two independent photographs; objects remain top lever/bottom lock. The intended broad-smooth versus narrow-smooth comparison needs less rough wear.

hangul.observations: Visible ordinary proportions, counters and word spacing; all entries read at usage720.

function_contact.observations: Rotation mount, useful lever grip, cylinder and continuous key insertion are visible; the material wear distribution is the remaining cause for repair.

local_material_edge_finish.observations: Broad flaky/scratched grip and mottled key head compete with localized hand polishing.

located_observations.observation: Lever and inserted key/cylinder are large and recognizable. Both are attached to visually similar gray door planes. Lever extends right from its round mount; key shaft connects into lower cylinder.

All seven entries are readable. Title is largest, subtitle close beneath, date and venue together, hours/free admission together, full guide address on the last line. Clear photo/type boundaries and no extra printed labels.
Square natural syllable proportions, clear counters, coherent black strokes and distinct word spaces. No obvious glyph collision or horizontal squeezing.

located_observations.location: Door, lever edges, cylinder face, key rim
located_observations.observation: Neutral grayscale and soft side illumination. Boundaries are generally coherent; wear is rougher and broader than the planned smooth contact patches.
Two hardware close views occupy the top and bottom and central white type connects them. Large title and photographs are the dominant shapes.

residuals.location: Top photograph, broad lever grip from x≈300 to x≈980
residuals.observation: The grip carries flaking-looking dark patches and dense fine scratch marks across most of its front. It reads as surface coating loss more strongly than a broad smooth patch polished by repeated touch.
residuals.impact: The assigned broad smooth contact-wear comparison is weakened.

residuals.location: Bottom photograph, key head center and perimeter
residuals.observation: The perimeter is brighter than the center, but mottled roughness is distributed over nearly the whole head.
residuals.impact: The narrow touched rim is present, though broad distress competes with it.

residuals.location: Central information area, lowest four detail lines
residuals.observation: The title and broad composition remain recognizable; the smallest details require the usage720 view for comfortable reading.
residuals.impact: Thumbnail inspection is a composition view rather than an assurance of all detail readability.
